allow: PowerShell($d = Get-Content 'LoRaWAN\\sensors_v1.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach \($p in $d.PSObject.Properties\) { foreach \($v in $p.Value.versions\) { "{0,-22} {1,-8} {2,-8} bin={3} png={4}" -f $p.Name, $p.Value.protocol, $p.Value.type, \(Test-Path $v.binpath\), \(Test-Path $v.photopath\) } })

PowerShell($m = Get-Content 'LoRaWAN/sensors_v1.json' -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach \($p in $m.PSObject.Properties\) { foreach \($v in $p.Value.versions\) { foreach \($f in @\($v.binpath, $v.photopath\)\) { if \(Test-Path $f\) { "OK       $f" } else { "MISSING  $f" } } } })
